_doc: Hydroxyapatite Ca10(PO4)6(OH)2 (010): phosphate scaffold + two Ca sites + OH- as a molecular species. target_thickness must be >= 17 Å (two formula units along b); with 15 Å the thinning over-shoots and no OH- arrangement can cancel the dipole. Expected: Ca20(PO4)12(OH)4, 88 atoms, symmetric, dipole 0.000 eÅ — matches examples/reference/POSCAR_hydroxyapatite_010_DFT.
